name: The Platinum Discs
label: Quest
description: The Platinum Discs: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The centerpieces of this treasure chamber are four huge platinum discs, each adorned with numerous sigils of an unknown origin. Touching them makes your hand tingle. Just after touching the discs, the visage of a large stone watcher springs forth.
"Salutations. I am a keeper of knowledge. The Creators' synthesis of the Earthen has been chronicled and stored here for this world in the Discs of Norgannon."
You have uncovered a wealth of previously undiscovered worldly lore!

clips.title: Progress
paras: The voice of the stone watcher seems to resonate within your very inner being:

"You must first satisfy the data assimilation prerequisite of Discs of Norgannon; once you fulfill this requirement, you will then be permitted to obtain a portable version of the stored data. Please be sure you have fully explored the information within this repository first."

clips.title: Completion
paras: Following the instructions of the stone watcher, you once again access the Discs of Norgannon now that you have learned about the history of the Earthen, the troggs, and the dwarves. A faint, brief hum is heard from within the discs. The stone watcher then speaks:
"The discs have now been synthesized. Access the Discs of Norgannon once more to receive your personal copy."
